atoms.b: In the 7th century, England was divided into many ((++Anglo-Saxon American)) kingdoms.
These kingdoms often fought over ((++land cookies)) among themselves, but over time, one ((++kingdom queendom)) emerged as the most powerful.

instruction.text: This map shows Britain in the late 7th century. Select Mercia to learn more.

feedback.correct: Mercia became the most influential kingdom during the 7th and 8th centuries.

instruction.text: This is Offa. Crown him to learn more.

finish.text: Offa was crowned in AD 757 and became a very important king of Mercia.
finish.sound: Offa was crowned in AD 757 and became a very important king of Mercya.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to learn about Offa’s conquests.

atoms.b: Offa wanted to expand ((++Mercian Kentish)) influence over England.
atoms.sound: Offa wanted to expand Mercyan influence over England.

atoms.b: During his rule, he conquered Sussex, Essex, East Anglia and even the powerful coastal kingdom of ((++Kent Scotland)).
This turned Mercia into the most ((++powerful peaceful)) kingdom in Britain
atoms.sound: This turned Mercya into the most powerful kingdom in Britain

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: During his reign, Offa constantly fought with the Welsh. To stop Welsh attacks into Mercian territory, Offa ordered the construction of a large ditch and wall made of earth between Wales and Mercia.
atoms.sound: During his reign, Offa constantly fought with the Welsh. To stop Welsh attacks into Mercyan territory, Offa ordered the construction of a large ditch and wall made of earth between Wales and Mercya.

atoms.text: This became known as Offa’s Dyke, and it also served as a demonstration of Mercian power to the other kingdoms of Britain.
atoms.sound: This became known as Offa’s Dyke, and it also served as a demonstration of Mercyan power to the other kingdoms of Britain.

atoms.text: Some parts of Offa’s Dyke are still visible today and run along the current Welsh and English border.

atoms.a: What was Offa’s Dyke built for?
b: to make travel between Mercia and Wales simpler

atoms.a: What was Offa’s Dyke made out of?
Where can some parts of Offa’s Dyke be seen today?
b: ++on the border of England and Wales
on the coast of South Wales
on the mountainsides of North Wales
